summary: Titles and thumbnails night for Disaster Desk, the first since it went promo-only. I retired the 13 Short topics, which promos never use, and added one long topic (the Ohio State Fair Fire Ball ride) re-checked against the CPSC investigation. I also proposed a long-video title and thumbnail test.
why: The long videos are not being found: Hyatt has 9 views in 4 days, Texas City 15 and Titan 0. This week's small-channel long breakouts (15-45x their subscriber counts) all name the event with a concrete stake and often promise 3D. Fire Ball has a 1.23M long reference on a 157K channel (7.8x) and 4 facts from the CPSC report. No event from the last 14 days was worth a long video.

findings.title: Long breakouts name the event, add a stake and promise 3D
findings.detail: Fatal Chain's Chatsworth video has 9.6K on 606 subs (15.8x), Last Altitude's 'Every Clue Rebuilt in 3D' 31K on 1.68K, and Time of Impact's Germanwings 'Final 10 Minutes' 17.8K on 397.

findings.title: Fire Ball 2017: the ride had passed inspection the day it broke
findings.detail: CPSC IDI 170727CFE0001: corrosion inside the gondola support beam, 1 killed, 7 injured, built in 1999. Coaster College's long video on it has 1.23M views.

findings.title: No recent event worth a long video
findings.detail: The Learjet crash is 25 days old and its preliminary report is still due. The Lake of the Ozarks Cirrus crash has no demand. The Viled River bridge in Russia injured nobody and has no cause yet.

changes.title: Long topic: the Fire Ball ride (stunt_gone_wrong)
changes.detail: Score 7.54, the top topic by score. Facts re-read tonight in the CPSC investigation.

changes.title: 13 Short topics retired
changes.detail: The channel is promo-only, so Short topics go unused. The next prune removes them.

changes.title: Proposal dd-long-title-event-3d
changes.detail: Test on long videos: the event's name and a sourced stake in the title, and a thumbnail cut from the 3D reconstruction.
